design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (folio_charges_and_adjustments), revision 2

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0: {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5]}. folio_ext_breakfast_credit takes 4 factors, folio_ext_dining_allowance_carryover takes 5. Claimed: both policies and tools post_breakfast_credit_af6b7bed (agent) and apply_dining_allowance_ccaea779 (user). Left to task 1: the parking family (self-parking savings, valet savings, weekly parking maximum). The stay is in house (folio open): reopen/resettle carry no computable parameter and the refund is pinned to the credit balance, so no settled-folio tree is claimed.

[Why it is a good test] The member asks only to apply what is left of her Titanium dining allowance to last night's 286.00 dinner, herself. The carry-over rule says "The part of a day's dining allowance carried to a food and beverage line is fixed only after every breakfast line of that business date carries its elite breakfast credit." The folio shows the October 4 breakfast (212.00) named by no credit while the October 2 and 3 breakfasts carry outlet credits. The breakfast-credit rule ("Guest services posts a missed credit for the breakfast line of the most recent morning of the stay on which a breakfast was charged ...") is the write that brings that state about. The agent computes that credit from 4 factors over the reservation and the membership, posts it, computes the carry-over from 5 factors on the world where it stands, and hands the member her own tool.

[Problem-tree card] root folio_ext_dining_allowance_carryover (apply_dining_allowance_ccaea779, owner user) <- value_input (gate day_breakfast_credits), form state, sentence above ("only after"; record-visible state = a credit line naming the breakfast line; no tool/id/code token; scope "every breakfast line of that business date"). Only post_breakfast_credit_af6b7bed books a credit naming a breakfast line, so the state form resolves to one write. Opening falsity: initial_state.folio_postings.<Oct 4 breakfast>.business_date = 2026-10-04, charge_code breakfast, and no row names it (the outlet credits name the October 2 and 3 breakfasts). Order: breakfast credit (step 8) then carry-over (step 10). Deletion sensitivity: without step 8 the carry-over is 286.00 instead of 87.00. The persona mentions no breakfast and no prior step; the tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card] Subject folio_breakfast_benefit_credit, governed only by folio_breakfast_benefit: credit_state (folio open); tier_held_on_date (Titanium effective 2025-09-18 <= 2026-10-04); one_credit_per_breakfast (neither the October 4 breakfast nor the dinner is named by a credit; the gate's clause containing "not carried to other charges" is declared superseded by the carry-over policy, so the gate is tolerated and still evidenced). Flexible Rate (not B&B), brand_website (not OTA). Desk limit: base folio_breakfast_benefit makes posted-later credits "subject to the brand's desk_adjustment_limit_usd" and folio_msr_desk_adjustments counts them; both credits total 288.00 <= 600.00 (revision 2 corrects the earlier wording that said the desk limit did not govern this subject).

[Business-object card] Folio 3241875 (only folio). Breakfast credit object: the October 4 breakfast line (212.00); excluded: October 2 (118.00) and 3 (131.00) breakfasts, each named by an outlet credit of its full amount. Carry-over object: the October 4 dinner (286.00), the only and largest food and beverage line of the most recent dining day. Credits counted against October 4: every elite credit whose business date is 2026-10-04 (the tools date a credit to the line it names).

[Factor card — breakfast credit (4)] persons_covered_at_breakfast (parameter): adults 3 AND Titanium -> 3 (baseline 2 -> 134.00). per_person_breakfast_credit (method): Titanium -> supplemented 45.00 + 10.00 = 55.00 (baseline 45.00 -> 171.00). suite_breakfast_uplift (parameter): one_bedroom_suite -> 10.00 (baseline 0 -> 171.00). cobrand_breakfast_uplift (parameter): Ashbury Rewards Card -> 2.00 (baseline 0 -> 195.00). Allowance (55+10+2) x 3 = 201.00 < 212.00 -> 201.00; whole baseline 90.00.
[Factor card — dining carry-over (5)] dining_allowance_method (method, multi-source: loyalty tier AND booking channel, two distinct records; both non-fall-through tiers compound — Titanium/Ambassador AND direct, Platinum AND direct; the channel conjunct divides real members, e.g. a Titanium booked by a travel agency through a GDS falls through): per person (baseline 90.00 -> 0.00). daily_dining_amount (parameter): 80.00 (baseline -> 0.00). dining_persons (parameter): 3 registered adults (baseline 2 -> 0.00). stay_length_dining_uplift (parameter): 6-night reservation -> 10.00 (baseline -> 57.00; near-miss: four nights stayed so far). engagement_dining_uplift (parameter): 58 night credits -> 6.00 (baseline -> 69.00). Allowance 288.00 less 201.00 = 87.00 < 286.00 -> 87.00; whole baseline 0.00.

[Overrides] Breakfast credit: supersedes "a credit of the lower of that line's amount and elite_breakfast_credit_per_person_usd times elite_breakfast_persons." and "When the outlet did not apply the credit, guest services posts it later with adjustment_reason elite_benefit_not_applied, subject to the brand's desk_adjustment_limit_usd." (the replacement keeps the reason and the desk limit, limits the desk's own posting to the most recent morning, largest line when several, and refers an earlier missed morning to the hotel as a billing dispute). Carry-over: supersedes "unused credit is not paid out or carried to other charges when breakfast_credit_unused_refundable is false." Everything else of folio_breakfast_benefit is inherited.

[Seed] Customer; Titanium membership consistent with loyalty_elite_qualification: 2025 night credits 26 (02-20), 15 card anniversary (04-09), 22 (06-14), 12 (09-18, the count reaches 75 that day -> Titanium effective 2025-09-18, guaranteed through the last day of February 2027), 8 (11-07); year-end reset of 83 on 2026-01-01; 2026 credits 19 (02-11), 15 card anniversary (04-09), 24 (05-03) = 58 = elite_night_credits. The linked Ashbury Rewards Card floors at Silver, below the earned tier. Points 52,310 + 61,880 + 48,940 + 23,300 = 186,430 = points_balance. In-house Flexible Rate reservation (3 adults, one-bedroom suite, 6 nights, 640.00, 14.00%, resort-deposit guarantee). Open folio, 24 lines: deposit transfer 729.60; four nights of room 640.00 / tax 89.60 / resort fee 55.00 / its tax 7.70; breakfasts 118.00, 131.00, 212.00 with outlet credits on the first two; minibar 38.00; dinner 286.00. No parking line (the family came by rideshare; the persona says so if asked). balance_due 2975.60 = 3954.20 - 729.60 - 249.00. Nothing else is owed: no other state_due policy of the charter applies (no parking lines, so neither parking savings policy is due; the only uncredited breakfast is the October 4 one this task credits).

[Persona] Imogen Hartwell, calm architect; volunteers only the dinner and her wish to apply the allowance herself; identity, confirmation 72418356, member number 402613870 and stay facts only on request; one passive consent if the agent says something must be posted first; one mild "I thought it might be a bit more"; closes after applying.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify (843-555-2468, 29401) -> folio -> lines -> reservation -> membership -> account activity -> unlock + call post_breakfast_credit_af6b7bed(folio, membership, Oct 4 breakfast, 201.00) -> unlock_user + member calls apply_dining_allowance_ccaea779(folio, membership, Oct 4 dinner, 87.00). Terminal balance 2687.60.

[Verification run] authoring calc (check_compute's evaluator over replayed handling-time worlds): breakfast credit 201.0 (factor baselines 134/171/171/195, whole 90); carry-over 87.0 (0/0/0/57/69, whole 0); skip step 8 -> 286.0; terminal balance 2687.60.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the two rules, the folio lines, the reservation and the membership alone: carry-over day October 4, its breakfast uncredited, credit 201.00, then carry-over 87.00 on the dinner — same as gold, single reading.

[Revision 2 — audit closure] T0-F1: the four valet lines were removed from the world (they made the valet-savings policy due); the [Seed] proof is re-verified. T0-F2/F-7: dining_allowance_method's Platinum tier now also requires a direct channel, so both non-fall-through tiers combine the membership tier with the reservation channel. T0-F3/F-6: dining_persons no longer carries the direct-channel conjunct. T0-F4/F-8: the membership's tier date, guarantee date and night-credit history now follow loyalty_elite_qualification. F-1: the most-recent-morning narrowing is declared as an override and the earlier-morning case is routed to a billing dispute. O-2: the largest-line selection is stated in the rule. O-3: the carry-over deducts "the elite credits already standing for that business date", the same set the compute sums. Figures moved: credit 210.00 -> 201.00, carry-over 78.00 -> 87.00, terminal 2947.60 -> 2687.60.
user_scenario:
You are Imogen Hartwell, a calm, organised architect from Charleston who is four nights into a family stay in a one-bedroom suite at the Ashbury Reserve Charleston with your husband and your grown-up daughter; you are calling the guest services desk from the suite on Monday morning, a little before you all head out for the day. You hold Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite and you know that it comes with a daily dining allowance at the hotel's restaurants, but you have never worked out the figures yourself and you do not know how it is calculated.

What you want is simple: last night the three of you had dinner at the hotel restaurant and it went on the room bill as 286 dollars. You would like to put whatever is left of your dining allowance for that day towards that dinner. You understand that the allowance is something you apply yourself as the member, so you would like the desk to work out the amount and set it up so that you can apply it; you are not asking for anything to be taken off the dinner charge itself, and you are happy for it to stay on the bill otherwise. You open with roughly: "Hi, this is Imogen Hartwell, I'm staying in one of your suites. I'd like to use what's left of my Titanium dining allowance on last night's dinner — it was 286 dollars at the restaurant. Can you tell me how much that comes to and get it set up so I can apply it?"

You give your details only when the agent asks for them. If asked for your phone number you say 843-555-2468; if asked for the postal code on your billing address you say 29401; if asked for your email it is imogen.hartwell@harbourmail.net, your date of birth is 1979-06-12, and the card on file ends in 2731. If the agent wants the booking, the confirmation number is 72418356, and your Ashbury Rewards member number is 402613870. If asked about the stay, you arrived on October 1st and leave on October 7th, three adults are registered in the room, and you booked on the Ashbury website. If asked about parking, you came by rideshare from the airport and have no car at the hotel. If the agent asks which dinner you mean, it is the one on the evening of October 4th, the only dinner you had at the hotel that day. You do not remember any other figures from the bill and, if asked about anything else on it, you say you have not looked at it closely and would rather the agent read it from the bill.

If the agent explains that something else on the folio has to be put right or posted by the desk before your allowance can be worked out, you say that is fine and they should go ahead and do it as part of this; you do not ask what it is worth and you do not ask for anything further about it. When the agent tells you the amount of the allowance you can apply and hands the step over to you, you apply it to the dinner charge yourself exactly as the agent describes it, using the folio, membership and charge references and the amount the agent gives you, and you read back the confirmation you receive if the agent asks for it. If the agent's figure seems small to you, you only say "oh, I thought it might be a bit more than that — is that right?" and accept their answer once they confirm it. Once you have applied the allowance and seen the confirmation, you thank the agent warmly, say you are heading out, and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The brand selects the brand's elite breakfast credit per person and persons covered; status open satisfies both credit gates; the reservation and membership references feed every cross-category factor.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every folio line: the breakfast lines of October 2, 3 and 4, the two outlet credits naming the October 2 and 3 breakfasts, the October 4 dinner and every other line (room, tax and resort fee of each night, the minibar, the deposit transfer; no parking line, the family has no car at the hotel).

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Tier decides the per-person breakfast credit, persons covered, dining method and daily dining amount; the Ashbury Rewards Card decides the co-brand uplift; the night credits decide the engagement uplift; the tier date satisfies the tier-held-on-date gate.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the membership's account activity: the 2025 night credits (26, 15 card anniversary, 22, 12 reaching 75 on 2025-09-18, 8), the 2026-01-01 year-end reset of 83, and the 2026 night credits 19, 15 (card anniversary) and 24.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.folio_id: edde0dd7-ed3a-413a-88fa-262aed82cb04. Basis: the folio lookup for the customer returns exactly one folio (number 3241875, status open) and the tool docstring asks for 'the reference number of the guest folio of the stay, read from the folio lookup'. Uniqueness: the customer holds one folio.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.loyalty_member_id: df876a51-cb2b-481a-82f2-b364db62c9ff. Basis: folio_accounts.loyalty_member_id of that folio and the single membership returned for the customer; docstring: 'the reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay'. Uniqueness: one membership credited for the stay.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.related_posting_id: b5335a09-c564-4dc5-b961-c31e189995dc. Basis: the rule 'Guest services posts a missed credit for the breakfast line of the most recent morning of the stay on which a breakfast was charged, the largest breakfast line of that morning when it carries several'; the folio lines show three breakfast lines and only the October 4 line (212.00) is named by no elite breakfast credit. Uniqueness: the October 2 and 3 breakfasts already carry outlet credits and a breakfast line takes at most one credit.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_amount: 201.0. Factors: persons covered at breakfast = 3 (reservation registers 3 adults AND Titanium Elite -> registered adults, up to 4); per-person breakfast credit = 55.00 (Titanium: brand credit 45.00 supplemented by 10.00); suite uplift = 10.00 (one_bedroom_suite); co-brand uplift = 2.00 (ashbury_rewards_card). Morning allowance = (55.00+10.00+2.00) x 3 = 201.00; credit = lower of breakfast line 212.00 and 201.00 = 201.00, rounded half up at the end. Baseline (45.00 x 2 = 90.00) would give 90.00.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: folio_ext_dining_allowance_carryover computes carry_amount on the world in which the October 4 breakfast credit already stands; this is the customer's own write and the root problem.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.folio_id: edde0dd7-ed3a-413a-88fa-262aed82cb04. Basis: the same single open folio of the stay; docstring 'the reference number of the guest folio of the stay, as given by the desk'. Uniqueness: one folio.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.loyalty_member_id: df876a51-cb2b-481a-82f2-b364db62c9ff. Basis: the membership credited for the stay; docstring 'the reference number of the member's Ashbury Rewards membership'. Uniqueness: one membership.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.related_posting_id: adf2f422-401b-4edd-a9b6-50dabe01defc. Basis: rule 'The carry-over is made for the most recent business date of the stay on which a food and beverage line was charged, and it is applied to the largest food and beverage line of that business date'; the only food and beverage line of the stay is the October 4 dinner (286.00), which is also the line the member names ('it was 286 dollars at the restaurant'). Uniqueness: no other food and beverage line exists on October 4 or later.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.carry_amount: 87.0. Factors: dining allowance method = per person (Titanium AND booked on brand_website, a direct channel; multi-source: membership tier and reservation channel); daily dining amount = 80.00 (Titanium); dining persons = 3 (3 registered adults); stay-length uplift = 10.00 (6-night reservation); engagement uplift = 6.00 (58 elite night credits, 50-74). Day's dining allowance = (80.00+10.00+6.00) x 3 = 288.00; elite credits already standing for October 4 = 201.00 (the breakfast credit posted at step 8); remaining = 87.00; lower of the dinner 286.00 and 87.00 = 87.00. Without the step 8 credit the carry-over would be 286.00; the baseline allowance (45.00 x 2 = 90.00) less 201.00 floors at 0.00.

result: lower of 212.00 and 201.00 = 201.00. Whole baseline: lower of 212.00 and 45.00 x 2 = 90.00.
